title: Implement filter option for sessions: show/hide subagent sessions
description:
## Overview

Implement a filter option that allows users to show or hide subagent sessions from the session list. This feature will help users manage clutter in their session sidebar and command menu by filtering out sessions created by AI subagents.

## Current State Analysis

### Session Architecture

- **API Layer**: `/apps/web/src/server/opencode/[port]/sessions.ts` - fetches sessions via `client.session.list()`
- **Data Hook**: `/apps/web/src/hooks/use-opencode.ts` - `useSessions()` manages SWR data fetching
- **UI Components**:
  - `AppSidebar` renders sessions as `SidebarItem` components
  - `Command Menu` shows recent sessions (limited to 5)
  - Session page displays individual session messages
- **State Management**: No persistent session filtering preferences currently exist

### Key Findings

1. **No Subagent Identification**: No existing field/metadata found in codebase to distinguish subagent sessions
2. **No Filtering**: Sessions sidebar shows all sessions without any filtering
3. **State Pattern**: Project uses Zustand with persistence (e.g., model store at `name: "opencode-selected-model"`)
4. **UI Patterns**: Checkbox component exists at `/apps/web/src/components/ui/checkbox.tsx`

## Technical Requirements

### Dependencies

- **SWR**: For data fetching with auto-refresh
- **Zustand**: For persistent state management
- **React Aria Components**: For accessible UI primitives
- **TanStack Router**: For routing
- **OpenCode SDK**: May need SDK update for subagent session identification

### Implementation Tasks

#### Phase 1: State Management Foundation

- [ ] Create persistent Zustand store for session preferences
  - Location: `/apps/web/src/stores/session-preferences-store.ts`
  - Pattern: Follow `model-store.ts` pattern with localStorage persistence
  - Store structure: `{ showSubagentSessions: boolean, toggleShowSubagentSessions: () => void }`

#### Phase 2: UI Component Development

- [ ] Create filter toggle component
  - Location: `/apps/web/src/components/session-filter.tsx`
  - Type: Checkbox or Toggle component
  - Props: `checked`, `onChange`, `label`
  - Style: Consistent with existing UI patterns
- [ ] Add filter to Settings page
  - Location: `/apps/web/src/routes/_app/settings.tsx`
  - Add new "Sessions" tab or extend existing tabs
  - Include description and toggle for subagent filtering
- [ ] Add filter dropdown to session list
  - Location: `/apps/web/src/components/app-sidebar.tsx`
  - Position: Near session list header
  - Style: Consistent with sidebar design

#### Phase 3: Filtering Logic Implementation

- [ ] Enhance `useSessions` hook
  - Location: `/apps/web/src/hooks/use-opencode.ts`
  - Accept filter parameters if SDK supports filtering
  - Apply client-side filtering if needed
- [ ] Update session filtering logic
  - Filter sessions array based on `showSubagentSessions` preference
  - Handle subagent session identification (may need SDK coordination)
  - Ensure filtering happens at appropriate level (API vs client)

#### Phase 4: SDK Coordination (If Needed)

- [ ] Coordinate with OpenCode SDK team
  - Confirm subagent session identification mechanism
  - Request API support for filtering if client-side insufficient
  - Update SDK dependency if needed

## Implementation Approach

### Recommended Pattern

```typescript
// New store for session preferences
interface SessionPreferencesState {
  showSubagentSessions: boolean;
  setShowSubagentSessions: (show: boolean) => void;
}

// Usage in sidebar
const filteredSessions = showSubagentSessions
  ? sessions
  : sessions.filter(s => !s.isSubagent);

// Settings UI
<Checkbox
  checked={showSubagentSessions}
  onChange={(e) => setShowSubagentSessions(e.target.checked)}
>
  Show subagent sessions
</Checkbox>
```

### Subagent Session Identification

**Note**: Current codebase has no subagent identification. Two options:

1. **SDK Enhancement**: Coordinate with OpenCode to add `isSubagent` field to session type
2. **Heuristic Approach**: Infer from metadata (session creation context, agent type, etc.)

- **Recommendation**: Start with SDK coordination for robust identification

## Files to Modify

- `/apps/web/src/stores/session-preferences-store.ts` (new file)
- `/apps/web/src/components/session-filter.tsx` (new file)
- `/apps/web/src/hooks/use-opencode.ts` (enhance useSessions)
- `/apps/web/src/components/app-sidebar.tsx` (add filter UI)
- `/apps/web/src/routes/_app/settings.tsx` (add settings option)
- `/apps/web/src/components/cmd.tsx` (update command menu filtering)

## Files to Reference

- `/apps/web/src/components/ui/checkbox.tsx` - Checkbox component pattern
- `/apps/web/src/stores/model-store.ts` - State management pattern
- `/apps/web/src/server/opencode/[port]/sessions.ts` - Session API endpoint

## Acceptance Criteria

1. [ ] Users can toggle show/hide subagent sessions from Settings
2. [ ] Filter preference persists across sessions (localStorage)
3. [ ] Session sidebar reflects filter choice in real-time
4. [ ] Command menu respects filter preference
5. [ ] No subagent sessions visible when filter is disabled
6. [ ] All subagent sessions visible when filter is enabled
7. [ ] UI consistent with existing design patterns
8. [ ] Accessible checkbox with proper ARIA attributes
9. [ ] Filter state persists on page refresh

## Technical Notes

- Use Zustand `persist` middleware for localStorage persistence
- Follow existing checkbox component patterns from React Aria
- Consider performance impact of client-side filtering for large session lists
- Ensure filter doesn't break session deletion or creation functionality
- Test with various session counts and types

## Priority Justification

- **Priority 2 (Medium)**: Improves user experience and workspace organization
- Not critical path functionality
- Can be implemented incrementally
- Enhances existing feature rather than adding new capability
